prompt: The video begins with a first-person perspective walking along a sandy path bordered by lush greenery, leading towards Castle Rock Beach in Meelup, Australia. The camera smoothly transitions from the shaded undergrowth onto the expansive white sand beach, where the sun casts bright, warm light across the scene. As the viewer moves forward, the camera pans slightly to reveal the deep blue ocean on the left and rugged red rock formations on the right, creating a striking contrast against the clear sky. The path continues, winding through scattered rocks and patches of grass, eventually ascending into a rocky terrain dotted with dense shrubs and trees. The camera angle shifts subtly, capturing the intricate textures of the rocks and the vibrant green foliage. The journey progresses deeper into the forested area, with the sunlight filtering through the canopy, casting dappled shadows on the ground. The environment remains serene and untouched, with no signs of human presence, emphasizing the natural beauty and tranquility of Castle Rock Beach. The camera maintains a steady pace, providing a continuous and immersive experience of the diverse landscapes encountered along the way.
